query: After ComfyUI PR #15063 the LTX latent upscaler is a ModelPatcherDynamic, but LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride still calls .to(device)/direct module ops on it, raising AttributeError before the first sampling step.

desired.outcome: OP-documented workaround: disconnect the latent_upscale_model input from LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride (native LTXVLatentUpsampler still works). Proper fix requires KJNodes to use the patcher API; not yet landed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
